title: Long term shifts in North Atlantic seabird diet composition
description: Supervised and unsupervised machine learning on 84 years (1933 to 2017) of seabird diet records from the British Isles (seabirddietDB). The raw records are harmonised into a Darwin Core style occurrence table with WoRMS AphiaIDs, summarised as a colony year by prey taxon composition matrix, clustered with Bray Curtis dissimilarity and NMDS, and used to train random forest classifiers that predict predator species and whether a diet sample dates from before or after 1990.
